the other day of a waiter that had a tip that said do better. And he said,
"Normally, you know, I could, you know, take this and be like really offended or
say these people sucks, but he decided to take it to heart." The next day, he
showed up to work and was like, "I'm just going to try and be the best." He's
like, "I'm going to try to remember everyone's names. I'm going to try and
smile, be charismatic." He's like, "And the [music] craziest thing happened. All
of a sudden, people were telling me I was so nice, and they started giving me
bigger tips, and they started talk to me about other opportunities." And the
thing is is that he was still doing the same job, but he was the way he
approached it was different. Did he become passionate about his work, or he
did did he just decide to see the larger picture? That the work we do works on us
more than we work on it.
